body.statement: The table \(v^{\mathrm{ex}}\) has strictly positive observed success and failure cells at both positive layers and belongs to \(\mathcal V_{2,49/100}\). Its observable quantities are \(\ell=(1/4,1/4)\), \(u=(7/20,1/4)\), \(a=(3/20,19/100)\), and \(b=(3/10,1/5)\), so its joint prism is \[\{(s_1,h_1):1/4\le s_1\le7/20,\ (s_1-3/20)_+\le h_1\le\min\{s_1,3/10\}\}\times\{(s_2,h_2):s_2=1/4,\ 3/50\le h_2\le1/5\}.\] The endpoint composition gives \(\phi(v^{\mathrm{ex}})=(8/25,10/11)\). Moreover, \(q_{01}-q_{11}=1/5>1/10=R_1-C_1\) and \(q_{02}-q_{12}=3/50>0=R_2-C_2\), so the unavoidable-harm certificate holds. The couplings \(\Gamma^-\) and \(\Gamma^+\) have the displayed observable margins and respectively yield \((s,h)=((1/4,1/4),(1/10,3/50))\) and \((s,h)=((3/10,1/4),(3/10,1/5))\); decoding them produces full-data response laws attaining the lower and upper endpoints.
body.justification: The exact rational witness checks the prism, the interior-hinge upper optimizer, the observable certificate, and both response-law attainments in one nondegenerate design.
body.gap: The closest papers do not provide an all-layer response-law table that attains both endpoints of a ratio with an unidentified same-layer denominator.
body.consumer: The table is a regression fixture for bounds software restricted to protocol-controlled tier assignments and a reproducible audit target for the constructive proof.
body.proof_tex:
We verify the witness by exact rational arithmetic and then audit both attaining expanded-state couplings.  All eight displayed positive-layer arm cells are strictly positive.  Summing failure and success cells within each layer gives
\[
 r=(2/5,7/20,1/4),
 \qquad
 c=(1/5,9/20,7/20),
\]
and the displayed success cells give
\[
 q_0=(3/10,1/5),
 \qquad
 q_1=(1/10,7/50).
\]
The nontrivial cumulative compatibility inequalities are
\[
 C_0=1/5\le2/5=R_0,
 \qquad
 C_1=13/20\le3/4=R_1.
\]
Moreover,
\[
 \ell_1=C_1-R_0=1/4,
 \qquad
 \ell_2=C_2-R_1=1/4,
 \qquad
 \ell_1+\ell_2=1/2\ge49/100.
\]
Thus \(v^{\mathrm{ex}}\in\mathcal V_{2,49/100}\).  Direct substitution gives
\[
 u=(7/20,1/4),
\]
\[
 a=\left(7/20-3/10+1/10,\ 1/4-1/5+7/50\right)
 =(3/20,19/100),
\]
and
\[
 b=\left(\min\{3/10,9/20-1/10\},
 \min\{1/5,7/20-7/50\}\right)
 =(3/10,1/5).
\]
The definition of the joint prism therefore yields exactly
\[
 \{(s_1,h_1):1/4\le s_1\le7/20,\ (s_1-3/20)_+\le h_1\le\min\{s_1,3/10\}\}
\]
times
\[
 \{(s_2,h_2):s_2=1/4,\ 3/50\le h_2\le1/5\}.
\]

For the lower endpoint construction,
\[
 s^-=(1/4,1/4),
 \qquad
 A_-=1/10+3/50=4/25,
 \qquad
 B_-=1/2,
\]
so \(A_-/B_-=8/25\).  For the upper endpoint construction,
\[
 s^+=(3/10,1/4),
 \qquad
 A_+=3/10+1/5=1/2,
 \qquad
 B_+=3/10+1/4=11/20,
\]
so \(A_+/B_+=10/11\).  Since \(B_-,B_+\ge1/2>49/200\), the ambient definition uses its ratio branch, and hence
\[
 \phi(v^{\mathrm{ex}})=(8/25,10/11).
\]
The two observable layer certificates are
\[
 q_{01}-q_{11}=1/5>1/10=R_1-C_1,
 \qquad
 q_{02}-q_{12}=3/50>0=R_2-C_2.
\]

Every displayed arc of \(\Gamma^-\) and \(\Gamma^+\) is upper triangular in its layer labels, and every mass is nonnegative.  Summing \(\Gamma^-\) by left state, in the order \(0^{\star},(1,0),(1,1),(2,0),(2,1)\), gives
\[
 (2/5,1/20,3/10,1/20,1/5),
\]
and summing it by right state gives
\[
 (1/5,7/20,1/10,21/100,7/50).
\]
The same calculations for \(\Gamma^+\) give respectively
\[
 (2/5,1/20,3/10,1/20,1/5)
 \quad\text{and}\quad
 (1/5,7/20,1/10,21/100,7/50).
\]
Thus both arrays are normalized feasible expanded-state couplings with observable vector \(v^{\mathrm{ex}}\).  Summing their same-layer arcs and reading their harm arcs gives
\[
 (s,h)_{\Gamma^-}=((1/4,1/4),(1/10,3/50)),
\]
\[
 (s,h)_{\Gamma^+}=((3/10,1/4),(3/10,1/5)).
\]
Their harm-to-stayer ratios are \(8/25\) and \(10/11\).  The expanded-network decoder therefore supplies full-data response laws attaining both endpoints, which completes the advertised constructive audit.
